label: Nebula (Drupal Canvas Code Components) with Canvas Workbench
append_welcome_text: Connect to a Drupal Canvas site (e.g. Acquia Source) with {BOLD}ddev canvas-setup{RESET} — or skip it and add the data later. {BOLD}npx canvas validate{RESET} / {BOLD}npx canvas push{RESET} then work against it.
Handy: {BOLD}ddev npm run dev{RESET} (Workbench), {BOLD}ddev workbench-restart{RESET}, {BOLD}ddev npm run code:check{RESET}, {BOLD}ddev claude{RESET}.
